text:
Jules: PSA: tried to run a client walkthrough and my neighbor decided to do hammer-time. Built a quick 'acoustic cocoon' out of a shower curtain + clothes rack. surprisingly worked for mid/high freq. anyone else hoarding weird soundproofing hacks? :ear: :hammer:
Priyanka: shower curtain is brilliant. also good: egg-carton-adjacent foam (not perfect but helps), and hanging a heavy blanket behind you.
Devon: move mic off the desk. put it on a small tripod sitting on a yoga block or hoodie. desk thumps travel like bad gossip.
Jules: doing the hoodie-trick now. also my upload dipped mid-call: ```
Ping 32 ms
DL 11.0 Mbps
UL 0.4 Mbps
```
Marta: 0.4 upl = rough for screen share + cam. fallback options: phone hotspot, reduce camera res, or ask neighbor for a 20-min drill window (bribe with cookies).
Priyanka: if you're desperate, add a second wifi AP and route laptop through it. travel routers in AP mode are lifesavers.
edgebot: ISP advisory: maintenance detected earlier in your area (Ref: MAINT-2026-204). Estimated restore window: 1988896000. Check provider status for updates.
Jules: of course maintenance. bribe plan in motion. will post cocoon construction pics and dramatic hammer-face if anyone's lucky.
Devon: mandatory photo rule enforced. extra points for a before/after speedtest.
Marta: also if you need a spare AP for a week, DM me  I have one gathering dust.
Jules: thanks all  deploying cocoon now. updates incoming (photos + possibly heroic hotspot rescue).
